name: University of East London

facts.text: UEL has three campuses: Docklands, Stratford and University Square Stratford (USS).
facts.sourceTitle: Finding us | University of East London (search snippet; page not fetched)

facts.text: The Docklands campus sits on the Royal Docks waterfront and is served by the DLR from Cyprus station, with trains every 5-10 minutes; you can also take the Elizabeth line and change at Custom House.
facts.sourceTitle: Finding us | University of East London (search snippet; page not fetched)

facts.text: The Stratford campus is next to the Olympic Park, a short walk from Stratford, Stratford International and Maryland stations, and is served by the Jubilee, Central and Elizabeth lines and the DLR.
facts.sourceTitle: Location | University of East London (search snippet; page not fetched)

facts.text: A free university bus service runs between the UEL campuses.
facts.sourceTitle: Finding us | University of East London (search snippet; page not fetched)
